statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ has rebounded toward the upper session range, but the pre-CPI path remains two-sided and does not verify persistent no-retracement structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold. CPI, the cash open, and Michigan sentiment are the main conditional path checkpoints.
headline: Pre-CPI NQ rebound holds near upper range; Tail remains WATCH
body: Delayed NQ was about 29,311.50 versus a 29,120.75 session low and 29,339.75 high. The 10-year yield near 4.94% and Brent above $103 keep Stress extreme, while lower VIX and broad positive technology context argue against treating the rebound as a verified pathological one-way path.
